main_text.p: & parum ante illud cibus subtrahendus. Prius vero vberius reficiendum, vt aeger sufficiat. Quibus verbis de eo morborum statu agit, qui in eo maxime fit tempore quo conficiuntur coctiones. Duos ergo praedictos modos tetigit morborum Hippocrates in dicto Apho. a quibus victus rationem inuestigare docuit, breuissime quidem vt solet. Cum ergo symptomata periculosa et vehementia inter initia fiunt, vt in angina, & pleuritide morosa, tenuissimo victu dum materia cruda est vtemur, prout ipse monuit in libro de ratione victus. Quod si aliter eueniant tenui victu vti sat erit. Nam cum talia symptomata eo vsq; durent quo ad coctionem materia recipiat, idq; non vna die sed multis fortassis fiat, consulte non ageretur, si tenuissimo victu to to eo vteremur tempore, quo materia cruda permanet. Repentinas praeterea mutationes 2. de ratio ne uictus.detestatur Hippocrates sub iis verbis: Nec repente quicquam huc, vel illuc, mutare in toto negocio licet. Quapropter homine hesterna die, solido cibo vso, omnimodam inediam hodie

page.notes: Marks at the left of several lines (small double strokes) are printed signs, not transcribed. The marginal note "2. de ratio ne uictus." is printed in the left margin; its placement in the text is approximate. The word "hodie" stands alone at the lower right and is taken as the catchword.
